b18_power_authorization.monte_carlo_tolerance: For each false-pass ceiling: point estimate <= ceiling AND upper 95% Wilson bound <= ceiling + 0.01.

c1_classification.MODERATE: G1 AND exactly one of G2/G3
c1_classification.WEAK: G1 AND neither G2 nor G3

cohort.source_rule: Only classes admitted under B17/B17A/B17D/B17E frozen source and joint-feasibility rules.

construct.actual_scalar: A_c = sum_{k=1..60} V[k] * I(actual selection k maps to QB/RB/WR/TE after FB->RB)
construct.pick_value_curve: Rich Hill modern NFL draft trade-value chart, frozen picks 1-60
construct.position_weight_rationale: Equal primary weights isolate fantasy-relevant NFL draft-capital composition and avoid importing outcome-fitted dynasty weights into the primary historical test.
construct.projected_scalar: P_c = sum_{k=1..60} V[k] * I(projected selection k maps to QB/RB/WR/TE after FB->RB)
construct.selection_index_definition: Selection order 1 through 60 on BOTH projected and actual sides; no phantom index is inserted for a forfeited nominal pick.

downstream_authority.c1_moderate: Continue evidence collection; no FV adjustment authority.
downstream_authority.c1_strong_if_robustness_calibrated: May authorize a separate Layer-D/shadow-calibration study only.
downstream_authority.c1_weak: Continue evidence collection only; no FV adjustment authority.
downstream_authority.shadow_cap_note: The +/-3% bound is a maximum authority, not a mapping. A separate preregistered calibration study is required before any shadow multiplier exists.

G1.association_test: one-sided permutation test of Pearson r between x and y

G2.procedure: Delete each class in turn. On the remaining n-1 classes require the same positive Pearson permutation test at alpha 0.15 AND LOO S > 0.

G3.observed_statistic: t statistic for positive x coefficient in full OLS y~1+year+x
G3.procedure: Freedman-Lane. Fit reduced y~1+year on all classes; permute ONLY reduced-model y residuals; reconstruct y*=fitted_year+permuted_residual; keep x and year fixed; refit full y*~1+year+x; compare the one-sided x-coefficient t statistic.

non_gating_future_sensitivities: calculator position weights only if their provenance is independently clean

objective.label: EXPLORATORY_LOW_AUTHORITY_PRODUCT_SCREEN
objective.purpose: Give Draft Capital Outlook one preregistered, one-shot test for a practically useful positive signal while limiting downstream authority because n is small.
objective.reason_for_redesign: The earlier confirmatory proposal was underpowered at attainable n and its original G3 residual-permutation method was defective. The objective and gate are changed before any historical capital scalar or predictor-target association is computed.

predictive_utility.metric: S = 1 - SSE_model / SSE_neutral on held-out log outcomes
predictive_utility.model: LOO clipped OLS: y=a+b*x with b=max(0, OLS slope) inside each training fold

synthetic_families.F2: bivariate t with 4 df using common chi-square scale and correlation parameter rho
synthetic_families.F3: Gaussian copula with gamma(shape=2) marginals and latent correlation rho
synthetic_families.F4: single-class dominance null: n-1 independent null classes plus one (+3,+3) class
synthetic_families.F5: shared-trend null: x and y each correlate with standardized class-year index at strength q in {0.3,0.5,0.7}, with independent residual innovations
